title: Hyperlinking Policy
bodyHtml:
Links to external websites/portals
At some places in this website, you may find links to other websites/portals. This links have been placed for your convenience. IPC is not responsible for the contents and reliability of the linked websites and does not necessarily endorse the views expressed in them. Mere presence of the link or its listing on this website should not be assumed as endorsement of any kind. IPC can neither guarantee that these links will work all the time nor it has any control over availability of linked pages.

Links to IPC website by other websites
IPC does not object to linking directly to the information that is hosted on this website and no prior permission is required for the same. However, we do not permit our pages to be loaded into frames on your site. The pages belonging to this website must load into a newly opened browser window of the User.
